summary.text: Tyler Johnson is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 14 since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He is a physician who works as an emergency physician.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and graduated from Leo High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Saint Francis in 2005 and a doctorate in osteopathic medicine from the Lake Erie College of Osteopathic Medicine in 2009.
His career experience includes working as an emergency physician with Professional Emergency Physicians, Inc. and as medical staff vice chief of DeKalb Health.
Johnson assumed office in the state Senate on November 9, 2022, succeeding Dennis Kruse.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education and Career Development, Elections, Family & Children Services, Health and Provider Services, and Tax and Fiscal Policy committees.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was a pro-life physician running for office to defend life and promote freedom, and that conservatives should not shy away from standing up for their values.
